about: Parity scenes: one per reference image, read by docs/reference/tools/parity.ts. viewport/dpr = the CSS size and device scale factor the real capture was taken at; crop = the region of OUR render (CSS px) that matches the reference; place = where that region lands inside the reference image (reference pixels; default the whole image, scaled to fit). route = the hash route that renders it (web/src/dev/parity). ref null = ours only, no real capture yet. See docs/fidelity/PARITY.md.

scenes.name: window
scenes.note: Owner's screenshot, 2000x1079, downscaled from the screen. Assumed: the window is the harvested 2782x1496 CSS window (NOTES.md/DESIGN.md) at DPR 1, scaled by 2000/2782 = 0.719 and sitting at x -9 (its left edge is off-screen), y 8 (a strip of another window above it); its bottom 4 px are cut. Measured from the sidebar border (x 197.5), the window's right edge (x 1991) and the top edge (y 7.5). The native min/max/close buttons in the reference are drawn by Windows, not by the page.

scenes.name: sidebar-user
scenes.note: Intentional departure (Jacob, 2026-10-04, PARITY.md): Projects, Artifacts, Customize and More are gone, so our list sits 106 px higher (4 rows of 26 + 4 gaps of 0.5); the crop starts 106 px higher and skips the reference's top 30 px (the More row). Owner's crop at 1:1 (the sidebar is 287 px wide in it). The left 66 px are outside the window and are not compared. y 165 measured: the 'connections' header text centre and the first row centre sit at y 45 / 72 in the crop and at CSS y 210 / 237 in sidebar.png (same window, 1:1).

scenes.note: Intentional departure (Jacob, 2026-10-04, PARITY.md): the chat list only. The reference's nav ends at y 176, ours at y 70 (New is the only nav row), so our list from y 70 lands on the reference's from y 176. The top and the footer are sidebar-top and sidebar-footer.

scenes.name: background-tasks
scenes.note: Jacob's screenshot of the real Background tasks panel at 1:1 (984x1688): its card is 805 wide there (the window was narrow and the panel took the rest), ours is a fixed 440, so only the left 440 px of the top 520 are compared: title row, the running card, Phases and the agent table up to Reaudit. The real word under the name is Workflow, ours CliMayte.

scenes.name: settings
scenes.note: Jacob's screenshot of the real Settings dialog (2000x1237, 1x) over a dimmed window; the dialog's edges read off the image by eye at x 186-1419, y 107-1032. Ours is min(920, 100vw - 48) x min(680, 100vh - 48), centred in the 2782x1496 window, so x (2782 - 920) / 2 = 931, y (1496 - 680) / 2 = 408, scaled about 1.34 onto the reference. Intentional departure (Jacob, 2026-10-04, PARITY.md): the real dialog's guest pass, Billing, Usage, Cowork, Chrome, Connectors, Plugins, Skills and the rest are gone, so the nav rows and the content below the first rows differ by design; judge the frame, nav, search, row shape, switch and select.

scenes.name: transcript-markdown
scenes.note: Jacob's screenshot of the real app at 1:1 (1137x1188): a SendUserFile caption and PNG file card, an answer with bold lead-in bullets and '##' headings, '18 background commands completed' and '1 running task'. Paragraph text at x 229 is our 1155 (column 1151 + 4), so the crop starts at x 926. The transcript is pinned to the bottom: the real '1 running task' row centre (y 1148) sits 60 px above the repo strip (real-running-task-and-attachments.png), whose top is our y 1367, so our y = real y + 159. The real picture above the caption (y < 64) is not ours to draw; the first 70 rows are not compared.
